title: Data Extensions
error-description: Something went wrong while loading. Check your connection and try again.
archive-confirm-description: It disappears from the API and can't be edited. Values already saved on records are kept, and restoring the field brings them back.

empty.fields-description: Add a field to store your own data on {{label}}. It's written onto the record itself and only your workspace sees it.
empty.values-description: Add at least one field on the Fields tab, then come back to fill it in on a record.
empty.api-description: The typed API for this record type appears as soon as it has an active field.
empty.record-types-description: Data Extensions isn't available for any module in this workspace yet.

sheet.record-type-hint: This field will be available on every record in {{label}}.

form.label: Label
form.key-description: Used in the API. Starts with a lowercase letter, then letters and digits only.
form.key-locked: The key can't change after the field is created.
form.type-locked: The type can't change after the field is created.
form.option-locked: Saved options can't be removed because records may use them
form.options-hint: Existing options can be relabelled but not removed, so values already saved stay valid.
form.api-preview-hint: How this field appears on the typed endpoint.

validation.key-format: Start with a lowercase letter and use only letters and digits (max 63)
validation.target-required: Choose the record type to link to

toast.created-values-failed: Created, but the custom fields were not saved

values.record-id-hint: Open the record in its own module and copy its ID from the address bar.
values.not-found: No record with this ID was found in {{label}}, or you don't have access to it.
values.id-placeholder: Paste the ID of the record to link
values.ids-placeholder: Paste record IDs, one per line
values.too-many-links: Showing the first {{count}} records. Edit these links from {{label}}.

api.title: Typed API for this record type
api.description: Every workspace gets its own GraphQL schema built from its fields. Sign in as usual; permissions are the same as in the module that owns the records.
api.null-hint: Keys you leave out stay unchanged. Send null to clear a value.

relation.title: Relation

kind-hints.manyToOne: Each record in {{source}} links to one record in {{target}}. A record in {{target}} can have many.
kind-hints.oneToMany: Each record in {{source}} can have many records in {{target}}. Each of those belongs to one.
kind-hints.oneToOne: Each record in {{source}} links to one record in {{target}}, and that record links back only to it.
kind-hints.manyToMany: Records in {{source}} can link to many records in {{target}}, and the other way round.

relation.inverse-hint: This field also appears on {{target}} and can be edited from there too. Name it here.
relation.inverse-label: Field name on the other side
relation.inverse-key: API key on the other side
relation.summary-source: Links to {{target}} · {{kind}}. The target and kind can't change after creation.
relation.summary-inverse: Shows {{target}} that link here · {{kind}}. Links can be edited from either side.
relation.target-hint: Any record type from an enabled module. Links store that record's real ID.

kind-hints-any.manyToOne: Each record here links to one record of the other type. That record can have many.
kind-hints-any.oneToMany: Each record here can have many records of the other type. Each of those belongs to one.
kind-hints-any.oneToOne: Each record here links to one record of the other type, and that record links back only to it.
kind-hints-any.manyToMany: Records on both sides can link to many records on the other.

map.title: Data model map
map.empty-description: Add fields or relations on any record type and they appear here, linked to each other.
map.legend: Lines run from the field that stores the link to the record type it points at. Click a card to open it.

field-type-hints.text: A name, code or short note

delete-confirm-description: This removes the field and every value stored under {{key}} on all records. It cannot be undone. Archive instead if you may need the values later.
delete-confirm-description-relation: This removes both sides of the relation and every link stored under {{key}}. It cannot be undone. Archive instead if you may need the links later.
